{{Top|leg}}
A '''magnet crane''' was a [[Magnet/Legends|magnetic]] device used to move heavy equipment.

A ceiling-mounted magnet crane was used in the control chamber of the ''[[Sun Runner]]'' [[False Sun Runner|counterfeit ship]] fabricated in [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]] by [[Groodo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] for his [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]-foiled attempt to destroy the orbital [[Fondor Shipyards/Legends|Fondor Shipyards]].

[[Droid/Legends|Droid]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] [[Hurlo Holowan]] used a magnet crane that was suspended from her [[Laboratory/Legends|laboratory]] in the [[House of Holowan]] in [[Kuat City]].
